title: Scoped HR requests a salary change and Admin HR approves it
actor: Rohan Mehta (Scoped HR: India; Support, Tech) and Meera Iyer (Admin HR)
trigger: Rohan opens Adjust compensation for an in-scope employee, previews a 5% base increase, and submits it; Meera opens the approval queue and approves

nodes.label: Rohan: Preview
nodes.does: Validates the form and asks for the backend's exact preview; nothing changes yet.

nodes.label: previewSalaryAdjustment
nodes.does: Untrusted entry point: checks the employee code and command shape, reads the session cookie, calls Express.

nodes.label: requireAuth (each request)
nodes.does: Reloads the caller's session, role, status, and scopes from MySQL on every request (F1 steps 10–14).

nodes.label: POST …/salary-adjustments/preview
nodes.does: Parses SalaryAdjustmentCommand and returns SalaryAdjustmentPreview (no write).

nodes.label: service.preview
nodes.does: Finds the employee in scope, loads versions and the band, refuses a second pending request, plans the change, and signs a preview token. Mode is SUBMIT_REQUEST for Scoped HR.

nodes.label: findEmployee + canAccessEmployee
nodes.does: Loads the employee by code, then applies canAccessEmployee(principal, country, department).
nodes.scopeRule: Scope is enforced on the employee here: Rohan may act only on India employees in Support or Tech. Unknown and out-of-scope codes both raise NOT_FOUND 'Employee not found.'

nodes.label: employees ⋈ job_titles ⋈ departments
nodes.does: Employee row with country, department, job title, and status (EMPLOYEE_SELECT).

nodes.label: loadContext
nodes.does: Reads every compensation version (baseline, future change, maxVersion) and the salary band for the role and country.

nodes.label: compensation_records
nodes.symbol: FROM compensation_records WHERE employee_id = ? ORDER BY version
nodes.does: All versions of the employee's compensation; maxVersion is the expected version for later checks.

nodes.label: salary_bands
nodes.does: Minimum and maximum for this job title, country, and currency.

nodes.label: compensation_change_requests (read)
nodes.symbol: FROM compensation_change_requests WHERE employee_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'
nodes.does: Is a request already PENDING for this employee? Also read for the idempotency key on submit and for Meera's queue.

nodes.label: previewTokens.sign
nodes.does: Signed JWT bound to the actor, session, employee, mode, the expected version (ver), the baseline version (bv), and a digest of the command.

nodes.label: Rohan sees the preview
nodes.does: 'Preview: nothing has changed yet' with Before | After | Change and a 'Submit for approval' button.

nodes.label: Rohan: Submit for approval
nodes.does: Creates one Idempotency-Key per confirmation of this preview (newIdempotencyKey); Try again after a transport failure reuses it.

nodes.label: confirmSalaryAdjustment
nodes.does: Validates mode, preview token, command, and key; SUBMIT_REQUEST goes to the request endpoint; a stale result fetches a fresh preview.

nodes.label: submitSalaryAdjustmentRequest
nodes.does: POST with Authorization: Bearer and the Idempotency-Key header; validates SalaryRequestResponse.

nodes.label: POST …/salary-adjustment-requests
nodes.does: SCOPED only (else 403); requires Idempotency-Key; parses SalaryAdjustmentConfirmation; 201 SalaryRequestResponse.

nodes.label: service.submitRequest
nodes.does: One transaction: findEmployee (scope again), lock the employee row (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), replay a known key, refuse a second pending request, verify the preview, then insert the request.

nodes.label: confirmPreview (version check)
nodes.does: Verifies the preview token for this actor, session, employee, and mode; the token's expected version must equal the current maxVersion and baseline, else STALE_VERSION.

nodes.label: compensation_change_requests (new)
nodes.does: PENDING request with the plan, requested_against_version, base_compensation_version, and request_idempotency_key; compensation itself does not change.

nodes.label: Rohan sees 'Pending approval'
nodes.does: After router.push to /salary-requests/{id}: loads the request (GET …/salary-adjustment-requests/{id}) and shows 'Pending approval since …; compensation has not changed'.

nodes.label: Meera: approval queue
nodes.does: Server Component for /salary-requests?status=PENDING&direction=asc: the pending queue, oldest first.

nodes.label: GET /salary-adjustment-requests
nodes.does: Parses SalaryRequestListQuery and returns SalaryRequestList.

nodes.label: service.listRequests
nodes.does: Request view SELECT joined to employees and departments, filtered by status, ordered by created_at, paginated.
nodes.scopeRule: scopeCondition(principal) in the WHERE clause: Admin HR sees every request; Scoped HR sees only requests for employees in their countries and departments.

nodes.label: Meera: Approve
nodes.does: Inline confirmation in the Decision panel; one Idempotency-Key (crypto.randomUUID) per decision action, reused on Try again.

nodes.label: approveSalaryRequest
nodes.does: Validates the request ID and key, reads the session cookie, calls Express.

nodes.label: approveSalaryAdjustmentRequest
nodes.does: POST …/{requestId}/approve with Bearer and Idempotency-Key; validates SalaryRequestApproval.

nodes.label: POST …/{requestId}/approve
nodes.does: ADMIN only (else 403); requires Idempotency-Key; returns SalaryRequestApproval.

nodes.label: service.approve
nodes.does: One transaction: lock the request (FOR UPDATE), replay a prior decision with the same key, require PENDING, recheck, then insert the new version and mark the request APPROVED.

nodes.label: recheck (expected version)
nodes.does: Revalidates requester status and scope, eligibility, date, future change, and band; the current maxVersion must equal requested_against_version (the optimistic version check).

nodes.label: compensation_records (new version)
nodes.does: insertRecord: version maxVersion + 1 with the proposed amounts, previous_compensation_record_id, changed_by_hr_user_id (Meera), source_request_id, and the decision key.

nodes.label: compensation_change_requests (decision)
nodes.does: This request becomes APPROVED with decider, time, and decision key; staleOtherPending then marks any other PENDING request for the employee STALE.

nodes.label: SalaryRequestApproval.parse
nodes.does: The approved request and the new compensation record, validated against the contract.

nodes.label: isSalaryRequestApproval (Ajv)
nodes.does: The Next server rejects any response that breaks the generated contract.

nodes.label: Meera sees 'Approved'
nodes.does: router.refresh re-renders the request page from the backend: 'Approved by Meera Iyer on …' and the new compensation version.

SalaryRequestList rendered; Meera opens the request and chooses Approve

edges.payload: proposed amounts, actor = Meera, decision key

alternatives.label: Stale version (409 STALE_VERSION)
alternatives.condition: compensation changed after the request was made (maxVersion ≠ requested_against_version, or a different baseline)
alternatives.result: The request is updated to STALE with the reason and committed; nothing is inserted into compensation_records; the API returns 409 STALE_VERSION. At submit, confirmPreview raises the same 409 and the UI shows a fresh preview. The unique key uk_compensation_employee_version is the database backstop.

alternatives.label: Second pending request refused
alternatives.condition: the employee already has a PENDING request
alternatives.result: preview and submitRequest raise PENDING_REQUEST_EXISTS (409). The unique key uk_ccr_one_pending on pending_employee_id is the database backstop (mapDatabaseError maps it to the same error).

alternatives.label: Out-of-scope employee
alternatives.condition: the employee is outside Rohan's countries or departments, or the code is unknown
alternatives.result: canAccessEmployee is false → NOT_FOUND 'Employee not found.' (404), the same response as an unknown code, so Rohan cannot learn the employee exists.

notes: Audit writes: none in this flow. access_audit_events is written only by HR access management (hr-users.ts). The salary audit trail is the rows themselves: the request (requester, versions, key) and the new compensation_records version (changed_by_hr_user_id, source_request_id, previous_compensation_record_id).

Idempotency keys: request_idempotency_key on the request insert (step 19 replay check, step 21 insert); decision_idempotency_key on approval (step 32 replay check, step 36 update) and operation_idempotency_key on the new compensation record (step 35).
Every request also passes requireAuth (shown once at step 2), which reloads the principal from MySQL; steps 16, 24, and 30 go through it the same way.
Admin HR cannot submit a request (403 at the route; Admin applies directly), and Scoped HR cannot approve (403 at the approve route).
